title: AI buildout hits snag as Google and Microsoft put off raising capex forecasts
description: Microsoft trimmed its full-year capex forecast to $170 billion from $175 billion, while Alphabet held its guidance at $195–205 billion. The cautious updates suggest hyperscalers are slowing the pace of raised AI infrastructure spending.

title: Microsoft recorded $10 billion in revenue from OpenAI
description: Microsoft reported $10 billion in revenue from commercial arrangements with OpenAI, including revenue-sharing payments, in the quarter ended September 30. The figure shows how significant the partnership remains even as OpenAI expands to other clouds.

title: Anthropic IPO might kick off tech reset if the AI stock underperforms
description: Anthropic's IPO filing positions it for what could be the largest initial stock offering in history. The analysis argues that weak post-listing performance could prompt a broader reset in AI-related tech valuations.
